title: 2026 Chess Academy Australia & New Zealand - Expression of Interest
description:
Presented by IMC and Team Liquid

What if your next chess move took you to Sydney to play the world champion?

The Chess Academy Australia and New Zealand is a one-of-a-kind program open to all students across Australia and New Zealand colleges and universities, whether you're a seasoned competitor or just love the game. In partnership with Team Liquid, IMC is bringing together the brightest student chess players in the country for a chance to qualify through an online Swiss-format tournament on Chess.com and, if you advance, travel to Sydney to compete in the championship finals against the best student players in the country.

This is more than a chess tournament. It's an opportunity to step inside one of the world's leading trading firms, connect with IMC's traders, researchers and technologists, and experience what it's like to think fast, compete hard, and perform under pressure — skills that define both great chess players and the people who thrive at the world's top trading firms.

What You'll Do

  • Compete at the highest level: Compete in an online Swiss-format qualifying tournament on Chess.com and play for one of the sports that advance to the championship finals in Sydney. 
  • Play Magnus Carlsen: All finalists take part in a showmatch experience with the World Chess Champion, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to sit across the board from one of the greatest players in history
  • Learn from the best: Finalists will take part in an exclusive masterclass led by Magnus and Grandmaster Robert Hess, an opportunity to hear how two of the world's elite players think about the game
  • Go behind the scenes at IMC: Tour IMC's Sydney office and get a firsthand look at the environment where some of the world's fastest and most sophisticated trading takes place.
  • Build your network: Connect directly with IMC traders, researchers, technologists, and recruiters. Whether or not a career in trading is on your radar, this is a rare chance to meet and learn from world-class professions

Key Dates

  • Applications Close: Sunday November 1st 2026
  • Eligibility Notifications: Wednesday November 4th 2026
  • Virtual Qualifiers: Monday 9th November, Tuesday 10th November, Wednesday 11th November 2026
  • Championship at IMC Sydney: Wednesday 9th December 2026

What You'll Need

  • Currently enrolled as a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate student at an Australian or New Zealand college or university
  • Participants enrolled at a university in New Zealand must also hold New Zealand citizenship
  • 18 years of age or older
  • A valid Chess.com account
  • Available to compete in the virtual qualifiers during the week of the 9, 10 or 11th November 2026
  • Available to travel to Sydney for the finals on 9th December 2026
  • Open to all majors and academic backgrounds — all skill levels welcome

Ready to Apply?

Applications are open to all enrolled students regardless of chess rating or experience level. If you love the game and want to test yourself against the best, we want to hear from you.

Apply by Sunday November 1st 2026.

title: AML/KYC Officer - Digital Assets
description:
We are looking for an experienced AML Officer to support AML/KYC activities relating to IMC’s crypto counterparties and digital asset business activities.

This role requires a strong understanding of AML/CTF risks associated with crypto markets, including exposure to high-risk counterparties, complex ownership structures, sanctions risk and enhanced due diligence requirements. The successful candidate must be capable of independently conducting risk assessments, challenging counterparties where necessary and applying a pragmatic, risk-based approach in a fast-moving environment. The role requires strong analytical judgement and the ability to independently assess and challenge complex counterparty risks in a fast-moving and evolving regulatory environment. You will combine analytical work with direct interaction with counterparties, front office teams and internal stakeholders.

Your Core Responsibilities

AML/KYC Counterparty Reviews

  • Perform customer due diligence (CDD) and periodic reviews for crypto counterparties
  • Conduct risk-based counterparty reviews with exposure to enhanced due diligence (EDD) requirements
  • Analyze complex ownership and control structures, including offshore and layered structures where relevant
  • Assess AML/CTF and sanctions risks associated with counterparties, products and jurisdictions
  • Manage escalations relating to high-risk counterparties and onboarding matters
  • Conduct independent AML/KYC risk assessments and determine appropriate risk classifications
  • Prepare high-risk cases and escalation memos for senior stakeholder approval

Screening & Risk Analysis

  • Conduct adverse media and sanctions screening using relevant screening tools
  • Identify and assess AML/CTF and sanctions-related red flags associated with crypto counterparties and digital asset activities
  • Review wallet-related information and blockchain intelligence outputs where applicable
  • Provide AML/CTF subject matter expertise on onboarding and counterparty risk matters

Stakeholder & Counterparty Engagement

  • Engage directly with counterparties regarding AML/KYC requirements and documentation requests
  • Work closely with Trading, Legal, Compliance and operational teams on onboarding and risk matters
  • Provide practical AML guidance to internal stakeholders on crypto-related risks and controls
  • Governance & Regulatory Support
  • Support AML/KYC enhancement initiatives and control improvements
  • Draft and maintain AML/CTF policies, procedures and guidance materials
  • Assist with internal audits, regulatory reviews and remediation actions
  • Remain current on AML/CTF regulatory developments, sanctions frameworks and industry expectations relevant to digital assets

Governance & Regulatory Support

  • Support AML/KYC enhancement initiatives and control improvements
  • Draft and maintain AML/CTF policies, procedures and guidance materials
  • Assist with internal audits, regulatory reviews and remediation actions
  • Remain current on AML/CTF regulatory developments, sanctions frameworks and industry expectations relevant to digital assets

Key deliverables

  • Timely and accurate completion of CDD analyses and periodic counterparty reviews
  • Effective handling of counterparty KYC requests and communications
  • Risk-based analysis of adverse media and sanctions screening alerts
  • Reliable and well-documented AML transaction monitoring
  • Up-to-date compliance policies, procedures, and documentation

Your Skills and Experience: 

  • 4+ years of AML/KYC/CDD experience within crypto, trading, banking, payment institutions or other regulated financial institutions
  • Strong understanding of enhanced due diligence (EDD) requirements and risk-based AML/KYC assessments
  • Prior familiarity with AML/CTF risks and typologies relevant to digital assets and crypto markets is preferred (but not mandatory)
  • Experience conducting independent risk assessments and exercising sound judgement
  • Familiarity with crypto transaction tracing and wallet screening tools is preferred
  • Knowledge of relevant AML/CTF legislation, including sanctions frameworks
  • Experience dealing with complex legal entity structures and institutional counterparties
  • CAMS certification preferred; crypto-related AML certifications are a plus
  • Strong analytical and investigative mindset
  • Ability to independently manage complex AML/KYC matters from onboarding through ongoing monitoring
  • Confident communicator, capable of interacting directly with counterparties and senior stakeholders
  • Pragmatic and risk-based approach to problem solving
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving regulatory environment
  • High level of ownership, accountability and attention to detail

What we offer

  • A high-impact role in a small, expert team holding significant regulatory responsibility
  • A collaborative, high-performance culture that rewards ownership and initiative
  • Exposure to AML operations across multiple jurisdictions
  • Support to obtain CAMS certification if not already held

description:

title: Chief of Staff
description:
The Chief of Staff is a high-visibility strategic partner that leads the coordination and strategic alignment of the Desk. Acting as a connector between trading and business support teams, this person ensures that the desk runs efficiently, communicates effectively, and stays focused on both short- and long-term goals. The Chief of Staff is responsible for owning crossfunctional initiatives, building the analytical basis for desk decisions, and enhancing the team’s effectiveness through better processes and structure. This is an operating seat with direct exposure to trading leadership and a path toward broader business and operating responsibility as the desk grows. 

 

Your Core Responsibilities: 

  • Operate at a tactical, strategic and operational level, handling the oversight of projects that do not neatly fit within the organizational chart or that fall between departments or leadership areas of responsibility.
  • Drive cross-functional desk initiatives and buildouts from initiation through delivery, managing scope, milestones, dependencies, and escalations
  • Co-ordinate business development for the desk 
  • Support budget planning, cost allocation reviews, and cost approval processes for the desk.
  • Support evaluation, onboarding, and ongoing management of vendors and external data providers, including cost and performance reviews.
  • Coordinate desk resourcing and staffing needs with recruiting and training teams.
  • Contribute to long-range strategic planning and cascade firm strategy into desk-level goals and deliverables. 
  • Own goal tracking and milestones; ensure communication processes are completed when goals are achieved
  • Coordinate, and lead desk meetings and follow up on action items; including
  • Promote information flow and knowledge sharing across teams working on similar initiatives. 
  • Serve as owner/main point of contact for all stakeholders in onboarding and transfer processes. 
  • Drive continuous improvement of desk processes, tooling, and communication.
  • Working closely with trading leads, proactively spot opportunities to improve efficiency of desk operations.
  • Support team culture and engagement by fostering connection, recognition, and collaboration
  • Own the desk's internal communication cadence, including planning and coordinating desk celebrations, offsites, and the holiday coverage calendar
  • Perform daily reconciliation checks on PnL and support outputs; identify and flag discrepancies directly to the relevant support teams before they escalate.

 

Your Skills and Experience: 

  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree
  • 2+ years of post-MBA experience in top-tier management consulting or a comparable structured problem-solving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across multiple levels, including executive leadership, without formal authority
  • Proven track record of owning complex, cross-functional projects and delivering results in unstructured and ambiguous environments
  • Strong knowledge of business, finance and analytics; strong quantitative skills and comfort working directly with financial and operational data
  • Proven track record of identifying and driving process improvements that enhance efficiency and communication
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with the ability to craft compelling narratives and build supporting materials (decks, briefings, and reports)
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach to building relationships across teams and levels 
  • Excellent organizational, verbal, analytical, and written skills with attention to detail
  • Interest in financial markets and a desire to build domain expertise in trading

While this is a hybrid position, we expect an in-office presence in our Chicago office 4 times per week.

title: Commodities Analyst – China
location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong; Sydney,  Australia
description:
Our Analyst team plays a vital role in supporting the trading desk’s decision-making. We are seeking a Commodities Analyst who will bridge the gap between market intelligence and trading. Working closely with traders, quantitative researchers, and technologists, the analyst will deliver real-time insights and conduct in-depth fundamental analysis to inform trading strategies.

By synthesizing data from global markets, domestic Chinese trends, and macroeconomic indicators, the analyst will help identify opportunities, manage risk, and ensure the trading team stays ahead of market movements. This position is essential to enabling fast, accurate, and confident trading in a highly competitive environment.

Your Core Responsibilities:

  • Conduct detailed fundamental, macroeconomic, and geopolitical analysis across Chinese and global commodity markets, with a focus on key markets such as oil, LNG, the petrochemical chain, base metals, and coal.
  • Develop a deep understanding of commodity value chains, including supply and demand dynamics, production economics, trade flows, inventories, and the relationships between upstream and downstream markets.
  • Track regulatory developments and government policy globally and within China that are relevant to commodity markets and trading.
  • Identify, monitor, and evaluate upcoming catalysts and structural developments across the commodity markets we trade.
  • Generate trading ideas based on expected volatility and market direction, working closely with the trading team to evaluate and execute strategies.
  • Monitor supply and demand trends, inventory levels, shipping and trade flows, policy changes, and other market-moving factors.
  • Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and research tools using Python, SQL, and other analytics platforms.

Your Skills and Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in a commodities-focused analytical role within the buy-side, sell-side, consulting, trading house, or a related environment.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong understanding of Chinese commodity markets, commodity value chains, and the macroeconomic factors that influence them.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data handling, modelling, and visualisation.
  • Familiarity with Bloomberg or other market intelligence platforms.
  • Fluent in Mandarin Chinese and English, both written and spoken.
  • High attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

title: Commodities Trader - China
description:
IMC is a global market maker, using advanced technology and sophisticated strategies to trade across major financial markets. With offices in Amsterdam, Chicago, and Sydney, we combine deep market expertise with cutting-edge systems to provide liquidity around the clock.

Our China Commodities desk trades a broad range of products across China's commodity markets, spanning energy, precious metals, and base metals. Combining market expertise, research, and technology, we identify and capture opportunities across one of the world's most significant commodity ecosystems.

As we continue to expand this business, we are looking for an experienced Commodities Trader to develop and execute China-focused trading strategies. Working closely with analysts, quantitative researchers, and technologists, you will help identify opportunities, manage risk, and drive the growth of the desk.

  • Develop, execute, and scale profitable trading strategies across Chinese commodities markets (e.g., energy, precious metals, base metals).

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of research frameworks, dashboards, and trading tools in collaboration with the Analyst and technology teams.

Your Skills and Experience: 

  • Proven track record trading Chinese and/or global commodities futures and derivatives with consistent risk-adjusted returns.
  • Strong understanding of Chinese commodity markets, macroeconomic drivers, and geopolitical influences.
  • Deep knowledge of Chinese exchange rules, margin frameworks, and regulatory environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate fundamental and macro analysis into clear trading positioning.
  • Experience collaborating with analysts, quantitative researchers, and developers in a data-driven trading environment.
  • Strong risk management discipline and ability to trade around event-driven volatility.
  • Familiarity with Python, SQL, Bloomberg, or other analytics platforms is advantageous.

title: Corporate Development Manager
description:
We're seeking a Corporate Development Manager to help build and scale IMC's external engagement function in India. In this role, you will be responsible for managing relationships with exchanges, regulators, brokers, and industry associations, while providing market intelligence that supports IMC's growth in one of the world's largest and fastest-evolving capital markets.

The Corporate Development team plays a key role in supporting IMC's expansion in India, covering all aspects of external engagement, market intelligence, regulatory monitoring, and project management. As part of a small, high-impact team in Mumbai, you will work closely with IMC's India leadership and trading desks to ensure IMC is well-positioned in the Indian market. The working environment is collaborative, non-hierarchical, and fast-paced. You will manage a wide range of stakeholders both internally and externally, and your initiative, judgment, and ability to build trusted relationships will directly contribute to IMC's success in India.

 

Your Core Responsibilities:

  • Foster and maintain excellent relationships with exchanges, regulators, brokers, custodians, industry associations, and other market participants through regular meetings and proactive engagement
  • Proactively gather market intelligence relating to regulatory developments, market participants activity, and market structure changes
  • Assess implications for IMC of SEBI circulars, exchange notifications, and RBI announcements and coordinate with stakeholders accordingly
  • Support the preparation and submission of responses to SEBI consultation papers, ensuring alignment with IMC's global advocacy positions
  • Manage the execution of business development and regulatory initiatives, including new market access, exchange product onboarding, and compliance workstreams. Keep key internal stakeholders informed on priorities and status
  • Attend relevant industry conferences and events (FIA, ASIFMA, ANMI, BBF) to build IMC's network and identify engagement opportunities
  • Invest in relationships proactively. Be a good partner to counterparts and build IMC's reputation as a constructive, long-term market participant

 

Your Skills and Experience: 

  • 8+ years of experience in Indian financial markets, specifically in one or more of the following: business development at an exchange (NSE, BSE, MCX), institutional/FPI brokerage (exchange relations or operations), or financial markets regulatory consulting
  • Direct working experience with NSE and/or BSE in a professional capacity (as an exchange employee or broker exchange relations manager)
  • Strong working knowledge of proprietary trading firms and HFT/market-making firms: must already know the relevant issues, have the judgment to assess what is and is not relevant to HFTs, and understand the role of liquidity providers in the market ecosystem
  • Strong understanding of the Indian capital markets regulatory framework: SEBI Act, Stock Broker Regulations, FPI regulations, margin/clearing requirements, and the SEBI algo trading framework
  • Working knowledge of how SEBI decision-making works: the hierarchy from government to SEBI to exchanges, the role of Advisory Committees and Working Groups, and the consultation paper process
  • Demonstrated track record of managing external relationships with financial market infrastructure (exchanges or regulators) in India
  • Strong written and verbal communication: professional, well-organized, and with attention to detail
  • Demonstrated initiative and strategic thinking: proactive, knows what they don't know, and has the energy to figure things out. Strong problem-solving ability. Not someone who waits for direction
  • Is able to establish strong rapport and represent IMC credibly in meetings with exchange officials, broker relationship managers, and industry association representatives. Strong personal values

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior employment at NSE (business development, member services, or regulatory departments) or at a large institutional broker's exchange relations team
  • Exposure to the HFT/algorithmic trading segment of the Indian market: understanding of colocation, algo registration, surveillance processes, and how exchanges interact with proprietary trading firms
  • Familiarity with Indian industry associations: ANMI, BBF, CPAI, FIA, ASIFMA. Prior attendance at or participation in SEBI working groups or consultation processes is highly valued
  • Exposure to commodity markets (MCX) in addition to equity markets
  • Existing professional network with FPI brokers, exchange technology teams, or regulatory officials

title: Hardware Machine Learning Engineer
location: Chicago, United States; New York, United States
description:
We are deploying machine learning directly onto custom hardware – and we want you to help drive it from the ground up. This is an initiative where you'll have the rare opportunity to architect solutions from scratch, influence technical research direction, and see your work drive real impact in one of the most demanding computing environments in the world.

We build the hardware, the software, and the infrastructure, so when you hit a bottleneck, you can fix it - there's no vendor to wait on and no abstraction layer you're not allowed to touch. If you've ever wanted to push the boundaries of what's computationally possible, this role is for you. We're looking for researchers and experienced engineers from any background. Trading experience is a bonus, not a prerequisite.

Your Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and co-design ML models with traders, quant researchers, and software engineers, treating hardware constraints (latency budgets, resource limits, numerical precision) as first-class design inputs
  • Shape our custom hardware roadmap by translating ML model requirements into concrete architectural decisions
  • Work hands-on with hardware engineers to implement, verify, and deploy ML inference solutions from proof-of-concept through production
  • Track and evaluate emerging research in neural architecture search, machine learning systems and quantization methods, and determine what translates to measurable improvements in our systems

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively across disciplines with both technical and non-technical teams

  • Familiarity with functional verification methodologies (for example SystemVerilog, UVM, Cocotb)

title: Information Security Engineer
description:
The Information Security team at IMC Trading is responsible for protecting IMC's intellectual property, IT infrastructure and business operations against external and internal threats. We work closely with technology, risk, compliance, internal audit and business leaders to reduce cyber risk to acceptable levels.

We are looking for an Information Security Engineer to help grow and mature our Security Operations Centre, which runs on EDR, SIEM, SOAR, CSPM, IAM, firewalls, NIDS/NIPS and a range of other security controls. Alongside SOC work, you will play a central role in supporting IMC's regulatory obligations in India, preparing evidence and coordinating the cyber and systems audits that come with operating in this market.

We offer an environment that lets you broaden and deepen your information security knowledge, with access to advanced security technology, frequent training and a culture of knowledge sharing. As you gain experience with our existing SOC technology and processes, you will be given considerable freedom to mature the function through your own initiatives.

 

Your Core Responsibilities: 

  • Analyse security logs, alerts and reported events, and respond to or assist with the remediation of incidents.

  • Hunt for potential compromise across the infrastructure using a range of threat intelligence sources.

  • Report discovered vulnerabilities to technology owners and recommend remediation steps.

  • Support and improve technical security controls.

  • Leverage automation and orchestration to remove repetitive manual work.

  • Apply AI-assisted tooling to alert triage, event summarisation and investigation workflows, with a pragmatic view of its limitations.

  • Develop reporting that measures the effectiveness of security controls.

  • Develop and improve incident response playbooks.

  • Support regulatory and assurance audits: prepare evidence, coordinate with auditors and track observations through to closure.

 

Your Skills and Experience: 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • A self-starter with a genuine passion for cybersecurity.

  • Previous SOC experience, and/or 3+ years of hands-on experience in an enterprise IT environment managing endpoints and applications on-premises or in the cloud.

  • Exposure to security controls such as identity and access management, vulnerability management, and endpoint detection and response.

  • Working knowledge of — or a strong willingness to learn — the Indian regulatory cybersecurity landscape: SEBI CSCRF, exchange circulars (NSE/BSE/MCX) and CERT-In directions, along with familiarity with ISO 27001 and the NIST CSF on which CSCRF is modelled.

  • Experience supporting audits (cyber audit, systems audit, VAPT, ISO or SOC 2 assessments) — evidence preparation, auditor coordination and observation remediation — is a strong plus.

  • Automation using basic coding skills or low-code / no-code tools.

  • Awareness of AI and machine learning applications in security operations is a plus; hands-on experience with AI-assisted security tooling or LLM-based workflows is highly regarded.

  • Understanding of common attack techniques and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into audit-ready evidence and regulator-facing reports.

  • Relevant tertiary and/or security qualifications are a plus — for example a Bachelor's degree in information systems or computer science, CompTIA Security+, Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), CEH, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer. If you don't have them yet, you will be supported to pursue certifications on the job.

description:
About the role

As a Macro Analyst at IMC in Amsterdam, you will build the quantitative tools and analysis behind the team’s macro research. Your work will focus on Python, data, maintaining the scenario record and backtesting research ideas, helping translate macro-event scenarios into inputs for the European equity index volatility curve.

Working closely with traders, senior analysts and the Lead Macro Analyst, you will connect your analysis to the desk’s exposure and evaluate your calls against market outcomes. We're looking for an Operational Risk Manager to join IMC's Operational Risk Management (ORM) team and lead operational risk frameworks and prudential risk across our European offices.

You will partner with Trading, Technology, Compliance, and other teams across the organization to ensure risk controls are appropriately embedded in systems and processes. The role reports to the European Head of Risk and is based in Amsterdam, with regular travel across our European offices (London, Zug, Aarhus).   • Partner with Trading, Technology, Compliance and other teams to ensure risk controls are appropriately embedded in systems and processes

description:
As a Performance Engineer at IMC, you will play a pivotal role in analysing, optimising, and tuning our systems' interaction with exchange systems holistically. Working closely with traders and engineers, you'll be tasked with uncovering performance improvements across the trading stack. This role combines technical ingenuity with creative problem-solving to outsmart competition in one of the most demanding technical landscapes.

 

Your Core Responsibilities: 

  • Black Box Reverse Engineering and Analysis: Analyse and understand the behaviour of complex, live systems — such as exchange connectivity and market data feeds — using black-box techniques, with no source code access. Design and run statistical experiments against real data to explain emergent real-world phenomena and identify performance bottlenecks and optimisation opportunities. This is investigative work aimed at systems you can observe but not disassemble, not static binary or malware analysis.
  • Experimentation & Prototyping: Design, implement, and build working prototypes to test ideas and technologies quickly — not specifications for others to build from.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Liaise effectively with traders, software and hardware engineers, and infrastructure teams to share insights and implement solutions.
  • System Analysis: Analyse terabytes of network data using statistical methods to identify patterns, validate hypotheses, and quantify performance improvements.

 

Your Skills and Experience: 

Most of the following will apply — we don't expect every candidate to check every box:

  • Comfortable using statistics and data analysis to test hypotheses at scale, not just qualitative or manual investigation.
  • System-level optimisation or low-level network optimisation — ideally applied to live/external systems rather than static binaries.
  • Strong understanding of networking, computer internals, and Linux systems.
  • Exposure to low-latency hardware technologies such as Intel CPUs, FPGA, or microwave links is a strong plus, though not required.

title: Representative Director
description:
IMC is seeking a Representative Director to hold statutory office for its Korean entity and to lead the operation of the business in Seoul.

The role carries the statutory duties of a Representative Director under the Commercial Act, together with the regulatory obligations attaching to the firm’s licence and to its allocation under the Responsibilities Map regime. It also carries day-to-day accountability for how the Seoul business is run: its controls, its governance, its regulatory relationships and its operational standards.

IMC Korea appoints two joint Representative Directors. The second appointee is the firm’s Head of Asia Pacific, based in Sydney. Joint appointment means execution requires both signatures. The structure is deliberate and will remain in place. The successful candidate will hold substantial authority and will exercise it alongside a counterpart rather than independently.

This is not a trading role and it does not carry trading profit and loss responsibility.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

  • Statutory office. Discharge the duties of a Representative Director under the Commercial Act, including duties owed to the company, and the reporting and filing obligations arising from the appointment. Serve on and chair the board of IMC Korea Securities Co., Ltd.
  • Regulatory accountability. Assume the responsibilities allocated to the Representative Director under the Responsibilities Map following a defined handover period, and maintain the standards of governance and control those responsibilities require.
  • Regulatory relationships. Lead the firm’s engagement with the Financial Services Commission, the Financial Supervisory Service and the Korea Exchange. Manage inspections, reviews and supervisory correspondence, and ensure the firm identifies and raises matters before they become issues.
  • Business oversight. Oversee the operation of the Seoul business and the effectiveness of local control functions across compliance, risk, legal, finance, HR and technology. These functions are organised globally and regionally. The Representative Director is accountable for ensuring the frameworks they provide operate effectively in Korea and meet Korean regulatory requirements.
  • Governance. Manage board and shareholder matters, corporate policies, licence conditions and local statutory obligations for the entity.
  • Escalation. Act as the senior point of decision in Seoul for operational, regulatory and reputational matters, and ensure timely escalation to regional and global leadership.
  • People Leadership. Lead the Seoul team and manage local staff matters, including performance, development and employment obligations arising under Korean law.

Your Skills and Experience: 

  • Regulatory standing. Experience as a Representative Director, registered executive or equivalent licensed officer at a financial institution in Korea, or as an adviser to institutions holding those appointments. Candidates must satisfy the eligibility requirements applicable to the appointment.
  • Professional background. A legal or regulatory background is well suited to this role. Relevant experience includes general counsel, head of compliance, chief operating officer or equivalent senior positions at a securities firm, or at a foreign financial institution operating in Korea.
  • Market knowledge. A sound understanding of financial markets and of market making in particular, including its function on an exchange and the operational and regulatory risks it carries. Direct trading experience is not required.
  • International experience. Demonstrated capability operating within an international firm and across a global matrix. Senior colleagues in trading, technology and the control functions are based in Amsterdam, Chicago, Sydney and Hong Kong. The role requires the credibility and initiative to work with them directly.
  • Language. Full professional fluency in Korean and English, written and spoken. The role requires precise communication with Korean regulators and with a global firm headquartered in the Netherlands.
  • Judgement and accountability. Comfort holding personal statutory liability, and the judgement to exercise authority soundly under a joint signing structure.

title: Senior Compliance Officer – Surveillance
location: Hong Kong, Hong Kong; Sydney,  Australia
description:
IMC's APAC Compliance team works closely with our Trading and Technology teams to manage the regulatory risks arising from trading activity across multiple jurisdictions. As IMC expands its systematic equities business in APAC, this role will help build the surveillance coverage, controls and technical analysis needed to support that growth.

As Senior Compliance Officer - Surveillance, you will be a senior individual contributor with broad ownership of APAC trade surveillance. You will remain hands-on across surveillance strategy, alert design, data analysis and investigations, covering equities, derivatives and commodities across multiple markets. Working closely with Trading, Technology, Compliance and Legal, you will develop controls that are practical, technically robust and defensible under regulatory scrutiny.

Your Core Responsibilities:

Your responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

  • Developing the APAC trade surveillance roadmap, with an initial focus on supporting the systematic equities expansion across new markets, products and trading strategies
  • Identifying market-abuse risks and translating new regulations, exchange updates and changes in trading activity into effective surveillance controls
  • Applying a structured investigation framework to alerts, including documenting the analysis, evidence and rationale for closure or escalation so decisions can be clearly defended
  • Designing surveillance alerts from first principles, including the scenario logic, data inputs, calculations, thresholds, exclusions, testing approach and expected outputs
  • Writing clear functional specifications and working with software developers to implement, validate and enhance alerts, data feeds and internal surveillance tooling
  • Using Python, SQL or equivalent tools to interrogate order, trade and market data; prototype analyses; test hypotheses; and assess alert performance
  • Reviewing model logic and vendor-provided surveillance, challenging systems such as OneTick or SMARTS, and developing bespoke controls where standard coverage is insufficient
  • Managing and prioritising alert queues, including high-volume scenarios, while maintaining investigation quality and improving false-positive rates without weakening risk coverage
  • Working directly with traders to understand strategies and market microstructure, assess potential misconduct and constructively challenge trading activity where required
  • Supporting responses to regulatory and exchange inquiries with clear, evidence-based analysis of trading activity

Your skills and experience:

  • Significant hands-on trade surveillance experience, preferably within a proprietary trading firm, market maker, HFT or systematic trading environment
  • Demonstrated experience designing surveillance alerts or controls from scratch, rather than solely operating or calibrating vendor-provided scenarios
  • Strong practical capability in Python, SQL or equivalent tools, including writing scripts and working independently with large order, trade and market datasets
  • Ability to interrogate alert and model logic, validate outputs, identify data-quality issues and challenge technology teams or surveillance vendors with an independent view
  • A clear and defensible investigation methodology, with experience distinguishing false positives from matters requiring deeper investigation or escalation
  • Strong equities knowledge and a practical understanding of trading strategies, order-book behaviour and market microstructure; front-office, trading or sales-trading exposure is valuable
  • Strong understanding of market-abuse typologies, including spoofing, layering, ramping, marking the close, wash trading and insider trading indicators
  • Knowledge of relevant APAC regulatory and exchange requirements, such as CSRC program trading rules, the SFC Code of Conduct or ASIC Market Integrity Rules
  • Experience across APAC markets, including any combination of Australia, Hong Kong, China, Japan, Korea or Singapore; experience with OneTick, SMARTS, Nice Actimize or equivalent is useful but is not a substitute for independent control design
  • Ability to communicate technical surveillance logic clearly to developers and explain and defend investigation decisions to traders, senior stakeholders, exchanges and regulators

title: Senior Macro Analyst
description:
About the role

As a Senior Macro Analyst at IMC in Amsterdam, you will take ownership of quantitative macro research and trading ideas across European equity index volatility and related markets. Working closely with traders and the Lead Macro Analyst, you will develop and test event scenarios that feed into the volatility curve.

This is a hands-on role combining macro research, Python-based tooling and trading analysis. You will connect your research to the desk’s exposure, assess whether it is long or short an event, and score your own calls against market outcomes to improve future decisions.

As you demonstrate an edge through your research, there is scope to expand into position taking and longer-horizon research.

Your Core Responsibilities

  • Develop quantitative scenarios around economic releases, central bank decisions and other market-moving events, translating the results into inputs for the European equity index volatility curve;
  • Build and own Python-based research tools, datasets and models that support event analysis and trading decisions;
  • Generate and test macro-driven trading ideas, using data and statistics to evaluate the evidence for a trading edge;
  • Work closely with traders to assess opportunities and risks in the context of the desk’s existing exposure, including whether it is long or short an event;
  • Record and score your own scenarios and calls against market outcomes, using the findings to challenge assumptions and refine your research;
  • Respond to new information and unexpected events, updating scenarios and trading implications during European trading hours and relevant out-of-hours futures sessions.

Your Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in quantitative macro research or a trading-focused quantitative role, ideally within a macro hedge fund pod or at a competing trading firm;
  • Strong Python, data analysis and statistics skills, with hands-on experience building and owning research tools and models;
  • Strong understanding of European equity index markets, options and volatility, and how macroeconomic and geopolitical events affect them;
  • Experience developing and testing signals or models, ideally including those you have built that have been used in live trading;
  • Independent research judgment, an understanding of desk exposure, and the ability to explain the evidence behind your views and objectively evaluate your own calls.

You will operate as the commercial counterpart to our infrastructure engineering leadership as we scale high-performance compute for both trading infrastructure and large-scale AI research clusters.

This role requires deep domain expertise in technology hardware procurement and market dynamics: GPU and accelerated compute platforms, server architectures, high-performance networking, component supply chains, allocation and lead-time dynamics, and OEM/ODM/channel commercial models.

title: Software Engineer - Machine Learning Frameworks
description:
The Machine Learning Frameworks team exists for two reasons: making the research iteration loop as fast and frictionless as possible, and making production run as fast as the hardware allows. Both matter, and figuring out how to do both at once is most of what makes the work fun.

Concretely, we build optimisers, code generators, runtime libraries, and the orchestration layer that runs computation across heterogeneous hardware. The stack spans C++, Rust, Python, MLIR, and CUDA. You don't need to know all of these things but should want to work at this level of the stack.

The work is broad. Some of it is high-level, looking at the whole compute pipeline, orchestrating the system and creating a cohesive product. Some of it is in the details, getting into hardware behaviour, dissecting compute graphs, squeezing the last bit of performance out of the hot path. Our job is managing the whole stack, top to bottom.

About you

  • You write production code in a systems language. C++ or Rust, or something close enough that picking them up isn't the hard part. The right tool matters more to you than your favourite one
  • You like understanding what a language compiles down to and how it runs on hardware.
  • You're comfortable being handed an unfamiliar part of the stack and working it out.
  • You like working with stakeholders and you’re good at figuring out what someone actually needs, not just what they asked for
  • You've done this commercially. You've owned something in production that other people relied on. Not necessarily big, but something you had to maintain, debug and live with long after you shipped it.

What you don't need

A finance background. Exposure to every language we touch. We hire engineers who like to solve the problems our traders face - we'll teach you the context on the ground

description:
The Development Platform organization at IMC Trading is focused on accelerating tech team workflows by providing self-service tools, services, documentation, and support. title: Trading Engineer - Execution
description:
We are looking for a multi-talented and passionate Trading Systems Engineer to join our execution development team. In this role, you will take ownership of systems that sit directly in the critical path of live trading, handling everything from hardware and network connectivity to application performance and exchange interactions. This is not a pure support role — and it’s not purely project-based engineering either. It’s intentionally both. You will split your time between:

  • Operational support of live trading systems, ensuring stability and rapid resolution of production issues.  This portion of the role is fast-paced, highly visible and requires strong troubleshooting instincts, clear communication, and the ability to remain calm under pressure.  If you enjoy solving real-time problems and seeing immediate impact from your work, this is for you.
  • Project-based engineering work, improving the reliability, performance, and automation of those same systems.  The goal is simple: fewer incidents, faster recovery, more proactive monitoring, and stronger systems over time. We believe production ownership and engineering improvement go hand in hand — the best way to improve a system is to deeply understand how it behaves under real-world pressure.

Our execution systems are fundamental to our success and require dedicated ownership to ensure continuity throughout the trading day. You will play a key role in both optimizing today’s trading and building a continuously better platform for tomorrow.

Your Core Responsibilities:

  • Participate in structured support rotations to provide real-time coverage for critical execution systems
  • Ensure continuity of trading operations, prioritizing and resolving system issues with urgency and composure
  • Diagnose novel production incidents, often coordinating across trading, development, infrastructure, and external exchanges
  • Monitor system performance and proactively identify risks before they impact trading
  • Build automation tools for system orchestration and operational efficiency
  • Eliminate recurring issues through root cause analysis and durable fixes
  • Partner with technology and trading teams to refine and deploy system architecture
  • Enhance monitoring, observability, and resiliency
  • Support and optimize core market connectivity

Your Skills and Experience:

  • Passion for problem solving and new technologies.
  • 2-5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Systems Integration, Production Engineering, or a related role in a heavily on-prem environment
  • 2-5+ years of hands-on experience with Linux operating systems, network configuration, and server management
  • Strong understanding of network fundamentals, including routing protocols, TCP/UDP, multicast, network offload, and kernel bypass technology
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash
  • Demonstrated curiosity and hands-on experimentation with technology—whether through personal projects, home labs, open source contributions, or deep-dive exploration of operating systems and networking
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering discipline (or equivalent practical experience)

description:

This role focuses on driving strategic execution, managing the desk’s operating rhythm, and strengthening team culture and cross-functional coordination. The position provides meaningful ownership and broad organizational impact from day one. Compensation is competitive and aligned with individual contribution.
